        public static void BindInsert(IDbCommand command, OddNames entity)
        {
            var p = command.Parameters;
            AddParam(command, p, "@quote\"d", entity.Quoted);
            AddParam(command, p, "@nul\0", entity.Nul);
            AddParam(command, p, "@bell\a", entity.Bell);
            AddParam(command, p, "@back\bspace", entity.Backspace);
            AddParam(command, p, "@form\ffeed", entity.FormFeed);
            AddParam(command, p, "@new\nline", entity.NewLine);
            AddParam(command, p, "@car\rreturn", entity.CarriageReturn);
            AddParam(command, p, "@tab\tstop", entity.Tab);
            AddParam(command, p, "@vert\vtab", entity.VerticalTab);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ctl\u0001x", entity.Control);
            AddParam(command, p, "@nel\u0085x", entity.NextLine);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ls\u2028x", entity.LineSeparator);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ps\u2029x", entity.ParagraphSeparator);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ünï", entity.Accented);
        }
        public static void BindUpdate(IDbCommand command, OddNames entity)
        {
            var p = command.Parameters;
            AddParam(command, p, "@quote\"d", entity.Quoted);
            AddParam(command, p, "@nul\0", entity.Nul);
            AddParam(command, p, "@bell\a", entity.Bell);
            AddParam(command, p, "@back\bspace", entity.Backspace);
            AddParam(command, p, "@form\ffeed", entity.FormFeed);
            AddParam(command, p, "@new\nline", entity.NewLine);
            AddParam(command, p, "@car\rreturn", entity.CarriageReturn);
            AddParam(command, p, "@tab\tstop", entity.Tab);
            AddParam(command, p, "@vert\vtab", entity.VerticalTab);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ctl\u0001x", entity.Control);
            AddParam(command, p, "@nel\u0085x", entity.NextLine);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ls\u2028x", entity.LineSeparator);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ps\u2029x", entity.ParagraphSeparator);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ünï", entity.Accented);
            AddParam(command, p, "@back\\slash", entity.Id);
        }
        public static void BindDelete(IDbCommand command, OddNames entity)
        {
            var p = command.Parameters;
            AddParam(command, p, "@back\\slash", entity.Id);
        }
        private static void AddParam(IDbCommand cmd, IDataParameterCollection pc, string name, object? value)
        {
            var p = cmd.CreateParameter();
            p.ParameterName = name;
            // AUD-R30: route through the same type-handler/enum-storage conversion the
            // reflection binder applies, via the public bridge in Extrode.Jaunty core.
            p.Value = global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.ToDbValue(value) ?? DBNull.Value;
            pc.Add(p);
        }

        private static void AddEnumParam(IDbCommand cmd, IDataParameterCollection pc, string name, object? value, global::Extrode.Jaunty.Attributes.EnumStorage? storage)
        {
            var p = cmd.CreateParameter();
            p.ParameterName = name;
            p.Value = global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.ToDbEnumValue(value, storage) ?? DBNull.Value;
            pc.Add(p);
        }
        private static class OrdinalMap
        {
            private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<IDataReader, CacheEntry> _cache = new();
#if !NET8_0_OR_GREATER
            private static readonly object _cacheWriteLock = new();
#endif
            [ThreadStatic]
            private static WeakReference<CacheEntry>? _last;

            public static CacheEntry Resolve(IDataReader reader)
            {
                var lastRef = _last;
                if (lastRef is not null && lastRef.TryGetTarget(out var last) && last.Matches(reader))
                    return last;

                if (_cache.TryGetValue(reader, out var cached) && cached.Matches(reader))
                {
                    SetLast(cached);
                    return cached;
                }

                var ords = new int[15];
                ords[0] = reader.GetOrdinal("back\\slash");
                ords[1] = reader.GetOrdinal("quote\"d");
                ords[2] = reader.GetOrdinal("nul\0");
                ords[3] = reader.GetOrdinal("bell\a");
                ords[4] = reader.GetOrdinal("back\bspace");
                ords[5] = reader.GetOrdinal("form\ffeed");
                ords[6] = reader.GetOrdinal("new\nline");
                ords[7] = reader.GetOrdinal("car\rreturn");
                ords[8] = reader.GetOrdinal("tab\tstop");
                ords[9] = reader.GetOrdinal("vert\vtab");
                ords[10] = reader.GetOrdinal("ctl\u0001x");
                ords[11] = reader.GetOrdinal("nel\u0085x");
                ords[12] = reader.GetOrdinal("ls\u2028x");
                ords[13] = reader.GetOrdinal("ps\u2029x");
                ords[14] = reader.GetOrdinal("ünï");
                var entry = new CacheEntry(reader, ords);
#if NET8_0_OR_GREATER
                _cache.AddOrUpdate(reader, entry);
#else
                lock (_cacheWriteLock)
                {
                    _cache.Remove(reader);
                    _cache.Add(reader, entry);
                }
#endif
                SetLast(entry);
                return entry;
            }

            private static void SetLast(CacheEntry entry)
            {
                var lastRef = _last;
                if (lastRef is null)
                    _last = new WeakReference<CacheEntry>(entry);
                else
                    lastRef.SetTarget(entry);
            }

            public sealed class CacheEntry
            {
                private readonly IDataReader _reader;
                private readonly int _fieldCount;

                public CacheEntry(IDataReader reader, int[] ordinals)
                {
                    _reader = reader;
                    _fieldCount = reader.FieldCount;
                    Ordinals = ordinals;
                }

                public int[] Ordinals { get; }

                public bool Matches(IDataReader reader)
                {
                    if (!ReferenceEquals(reader, _reader))
                        return false;

                    if (reader.FieldCount != _fieldCount)
                        return false;

                    var ord0 = Ordinals[0];
                    if ((uint)ord0 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord0), "back\\slash", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord1 = Ordinals[1];
                    if ((uint)ord1 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord1), "quote\"d", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord2 = Ordinals[2];
                    if ((uint)ord2 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord2), "nul\0", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord3 = Ordinals[3];
                    if ((uint)ord3 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord3), "bell\a", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord4 = Ordinals[4];
                    if ((uint)ord4 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord4), "back\bspace", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord5 = Ordinals[5];
                    if ((uint)ord5 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord5), "form\ffeed", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord6 = Ordinals[6];
                    if ((uint)ord6 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord6), "new\nline", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord7 = Ordinals[7];
                    if ((uint)ord7 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord7), "car\rreturn", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord8 = Ordinals[8];
                    if ((uint)ord8 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord8), "tab\tstop", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord9 = Ordinals[9];
                    if ((uint)ord9 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord9), "vert\vtab", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord10 = Ordinals[10];
                    if ((uint)ord10 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord10), "ctl\u0001x", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord11 = Ordinals[11];
                    if ((uint)ord11 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord11), "nel\u0085x", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord12 = Ordinals[12];
                    if ((uint)ord12 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord12), "ls\u2028x", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord13 = Ordinals[13];
                    if ((uint)ord13 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord13), "ps\u2029x", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord14 = Ordinals[14];
                    if ((uint)ord14 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord14), "ünï", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
